name: @underwoodinc/requirements-tracer
description: Requirements traceability tool: scans test files, audits trace IDs against a requirements registry, generates a self-contained HTML report, and posts PR comments.
author: inc.underwood

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const p='dist/plugs/html'; fs.mkdirSync(p,{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('src/plugs/html/mappyReportClient.template.js', p+'/mappyReportClient.template.js');"
